The '''95th''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] unit of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. During the war, the 95th and [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] were deployed at the [[Battle of Lanteeb]].

==Description==
The 95th was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] formation within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The unit was stationed on the [[Wullf Yularen's battle group|battle group]] led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and utilized [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] for transportation.<ref name="Siege" />

==History==
The 95th participated in the [[Battle of Lanteeb]], an engagement on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. After Admiral Yularen and his [[Battle group/Legends|enhanced battle group]] broke through the Separatist [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] took the 95th and [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] down to the surface of Lanteeb to rescue [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from Separatist forces.<ref name="Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 95th debuted in<ref name="Siege" /> the [[2010]]<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=catalog/display.pperl?isbn=9780345509000|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Gambit: Siege}}</ref> novel ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]'', which was authored by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="Siege" />
